en: A black‑and‑white vintage photograph showing a quiet cobblestone street bordered by small young trees. On the left are low, whitewashed buildings with arched doorways and shuttered windows. Further back stands a small, square tower with a hipped roof and chimney, and behind it a pointed church-like spire rising from the trees. On the right side of the street is a building with striped awnings over its windows. The print has worn, scalloped edges typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
